why: Decide whether the Kitui borehole rehabilitation program can make a defensible public claim about reduced childhood waterborne disease, and at what strength.
what: Immediately: a validated causal model of the program's theory of change with its evidence mapped onto it. Finally: a validation report stating the attainable claim tier, and — if an authorized reviewer approves — an outcome certificate worded to exactly that tier.
who: You supply the theory of change and the evidence, and confirm the outcome wording. Specialist agents extract, model, and check. The Kitui County Outcomes Authority reviews and issues.
where: Accepted sources are listed below. Everything durable is written to runs/wf-clean-water-001/. External systems: the evaluations engine (claim submission and receipts) and the graph oracle (ExternalSource checks).

outcome_focus.statement: Reduced under-five waterborne disease incidence in the program catchment.

sources.label: Safe Water for Kitui — program theory of change (narrative, 4pp)

exclusions: Cost-effectiveness and value-for-money are out of scope: no financial data was supplied.
Water points outside the registered Kitui catchment are excluded, including the three sites added after 2026-06-30.
Adult diarrheal disease is out of scope; the claim is limited to under-fives.
